# Blob trophy

Type: Trophy | Internal ID: TrophyBlob | Source: Blob | Usage: Crafting, Decoration | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes

# Introduction

The Blob Trophy is a rare drop from Blobs in the Swamp.

### Crafting

• Blob bomb Poison
• Blob bomb Elite poison

### Misc

• Can be displayed on an Item stand.
• Can be used to program Ballistas.

Categorias: Trophies
